change_summary: Fixed kernel_function grid to use lambda meta with meta['XBLOCK'] and meta['YBLOCK'] (eliminating the hardcoded YBLOCK=8 bug), and expanded @triton.autotune configs from 5 to 10 by adding XBLOCK=512/256 with YBLOCK=8/16/32 configurations to better amortize uncoalesced store overhead.

    # Y now covers HW spatial (xnumel=31500)
